Settings

Never Sleep App

System Autostart, pin window, video detection & uptime
Start with Windows automatically, pin the app on top of other windows, pause sleep prevention when a video is playing, and track your session uptime.
Black Screen (Darken) Darken time, countdown, minimize & darken methods
Default
Set how long before the screen darkens, show a countdown popup beforehand, choose your darken method (overlay, display sleep, gamma, DDC/CI & more), and configure auto-minimize.
Appearance & Design Language, theme, and app styling
Customize
Switch UI language, pick a theme color, choose between Classic, Liquid Glass, or Coffee view modes, and change the app tray icon.
Schedule Automated wake & sleep time profiles
Off
Define time windows when the app actively keeps your PC awake. Outside those hours, sleep prevention is automatically paused until the next profile starts.
Notifications Alerts, sounds, and reminder timing
On
Enable or disable Windows toast notifications, toggle system sounds, and set a break reminder that alerts you after a chosen interval.

Darken Method Choose how monitors are darkened or put to sleep
Overlay Window Default
Default. Transparent/black HTML window overlay.
Display Sleep (Standby) Recommended
Powers down monitor backlights. Wakes instantly on activity.
Win32 Black Window Native Win32
Lightweight native black window with mouse pass-through.
Gamma Ramp Blackout GPU LUT
Direct GPU display dimming to pure black without any windows.
Hardware DDC/CI (Native) Windows dxva2
Sends hardware standby signals to DDC/CI monitors and automatically overlays black on laptop or non-DDC/CI displays.
ControlMyMonitor (NirSoft) NirSoft CLI
Uses NirSoft CLI tool to trigger monitor power standby.
